name: Summit AZ - Blog - Are Water Softeners Worth It
body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-06-22

# Summary
Informational guide for East Valley homeowners on whether a water softener is worth it given very hard water. Published 2026-06-22 at `/blog/are-water-softeners-worth-it/` (ID 5821 in the June list). Arizona-native post (no Utah original).

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: are water softeners worth it. SEO title (55 chars): "Are Water Softeners Worth It? An Arizona Homeowner Guide".
- Links: `/water-softeners/` pillar, softener installation Chandler and Gilbert, water filtration systems, sibling hard-water post, contact. Reciprocal link to `/blog/low-water-pressure-shower-only/` held until it went live (target 14 Aug 2026).
- Only numeric claim (180 mg/L as "very hard") is cited to USGS; cost described by factor, not by number. EPA WaterSense supports the efficiency framing.
- Body about 1,180 words; cannibalization pass vs the hard-water post.
- Later Rank Math edits: the 2026-09-15 focus keyword backup and the 2026-10-16 title backup both list this post (see [Summit AZ - Backups Log](lib:brain-summit-az-backups-log)).

# Versions
- `.md`, `.html`, `_wp2\` and `_wp_new\` WP-ready versions with banner and inline images.
